carmen: Quick heads-up from the weekly entitlement-sanitization run: 87 admin-ish grants with owner=null and >75d inactivity. report: https://internal/reports/access/4412 :mag:
audit-bot: scan-summary: ownerless_admins=87 stale_days=75 risk=0.41
leo: can you drop a tiny sample?
carmen: sample rows:
```
g-0x77aa svc-ledger-cron -> roles/infra-admin -> last_used=2025-10-09
g-0x77ab rachel@oldcorp.com -> roles/org-admin -> last_used=null
g-0x77ac kms-secret-rotator -> roles/kms-admin -> last_used=2026-01-03
```
dina: KMS bindings are sensitive. we should never auto-rotate or remove kms-admin grants without a key-policy ownership map and platform ops signoff.
leo: proposed low-blast plan:
  1) Tag all ownerless grants with sec:cleanup-4412 for tracking
  2) Build quarantine dashboard and read-only view for SRE/Platform
  3) Kick owner-claim flow (7d TTL) for human-like principals
  4) For svc accounts with last_used>180d: apply "deny:token:mint" guard for 48h canary (non-KMS)
  5) KMS grants: monitor only + manual outreach to platform-oncall

carmen: command to tag an example (internal tool):
```bash
entctl tag grant --id g-0x77aa --tag sec:cleanup-4412 --reason "ownerless-scan-2026-03"
```
dina: canary details: pick 10 non-KMS svc grants across regions, apply deny-token policy for 48h, run smoke-tests (3 runs) against rotated-service-account, success threshold >=99%. monitor: cron-fail-rate, job-latency, and error paging.
leo: SQL I used to find suspects (shareable):
```sql
SELECT id, principal, role, owner, last_used
FROM grants
WHERE owner IS NULL AND role ILIKE '%admin%'
ORDER BY last_used NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 200;
```
carmen: audit change: add remediation_ticket and remediation_actor to grant-change events so we can trace remediation and rollback.
audit-bot: audit-sink updated: added fields remediation_ticket, remediation_actor to write events.
oncall-bot: reminder set: incident follow-up in 72h.
dina: owners: carmen -> incident lead + audit artifacts, leo -> canary orchestration + smoke-harness, dina -> platform/KMS outreach. tagging @leo @dina :white_check_mark:
leo: will post the 10-grant canary manifest in this channel before EOD and open the ops-runbook PR with rollback snippets for reattaching cron principals. :hourglass:
carmen: timeline: canary kickoff 2026-03-25 09:00 PT, 48h window. if green, plan phased remediation across remaining grants over a week with comms.
